summary: layer2-sdk@1.0.1 executes base64-decoded payload at load time
details: index.js line 75 decodes a base64-encoded string via Buffer.from(..., 'base64').toString('utf8') and passes the result to an evaluator, executing hidden code when the module is loaded. The obfuscated-and-exec'd blob pattern in a package presenting itself as a generic SDK is consistent with a supply-chain dropper: the actual behavior is concealed from casual inspection of the source and runs as a side effect of require()'ing the package. The package name suggests a blockchain/Layer-2 SDK, but the shipped code's only notable operation is decoding and executing an opaque payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
